description: This script automates the creation of a styled DMG file on macOS, including setting background images, positioning icons, mounting the filesystem, and resizing the disk image. It is used for packaging an application bundle into a user-friendly disk image for distribution.

methods.name: to_applescript_list4
methods.description: Converts a line of four space-separated values into an AppleScript list format.

methods.name: to_applescript_pair
methods.description: Converts a line of two space-separated values into an AppleScript pair format.
